name: aurora-veil
title: Aurora veil
description: Skewed curtains of colour drift in from the top-right corner. It loops with no join.

props.name: colors
props.doc: Up to five curtain colours, repeated when there are fewer. The third is the brightest band.

props.name: mode
props.doc: Dark or light ground; the curtains are brighter on dark.

props.name: ground
props.doc: Ground colour. Leave empty to use the mode default (#0a0a0a dark, #ffffff light).

props.name: intensity
props.doc: How strongly the curtains show over the ground.

props.name: fade
props.doc: Fade the curtains out from the top-right corner; off fills the whole frame.

props.name: speed
props.doc: Drift speed: 2 is twice as fast, 0.5 half as fast.
